summary: Underneath it, deep feelings and a strong need to feel safe and an appetite for more and a need to believe in something work together when you choose to use them. body: Underneath it, deep feelings and a strong need to feel safe and an appetite for more and a need to believe in something work together when you choose to use them. The opening is there: you read people and care on instinct, you reach, grow, and lift the room. It rewards you when you reach for it. Warmth and generosity that draw people in; watch the tendency to overextend. Comfort may come more naturally here. Emotional safety can grow through generosity, trust, and the feeling that there is enough room for what you feel.
gift: At your best: you read people and care on instinct, and you reach, grow, and lift the room.
shadow: The trap: your moods run you, or you bury what you actually need — or you overreach, overpromise, or talk bigger than you deliver.
integration: Let emotional needs and growth and belief cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Warmth and generosity that draw people in; watch the tendency to overextend.
do: Use it on purpose, not on reflex
Let you read people and you reach, grow, work together
When it spikes, name it before you act
dont: Let the reflex make the decision
